notablePrerequisites:
You have a nonartifact creature card in hand with mana value 4 or greater or with {X} in its mana cost that can be cast using only one color of mana.
You control a nonartifact creature card with mana value 4 or greater or with {X} in its mana cost that can be cast using only one color of mana.
Helga does not have summoning sickness.
Helga has a power that is equal to or greater than 4 or the highest mana value among the generic creatures, whichever is greater.
description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding an amount of any one color of mana equal to its power that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or creature spells with {X} in their mana cost.
Cast the creature with mana value 4 or greater or {X} in its mana cost by paying its mana cost, ensuring to spend at least four total mana if needed.
Helga triggers, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the other creature with mana value 4 or greater or {X} in its mana cost from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Helga.
Repeat.
